mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_favorite (user_id, book_id, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, b.isbn, b.categories, b.summary, b.cover_url AS coverUrl FROM book_favorite f JOIN books b ON b.id = f.book_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.created_time DESC
